issues.reason: The instruction set makes the per-member rule determined, not optional — a distributive predicate over a grouped plural "keeps the group event … and ADDS the per-member rule over (PartOf $x <group>)", and lighting is per-lantern, not collective — so the parse applies the doctrine to the traders and withholds it from the lanterns within one record.

defect_summary: The lighting clause needs the same per-member emission the traders got: (Implication (PartOf $x sk_lanterns_1) (And (Member (sk_light $x) light) (Patient (sk_light $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9) beside the existing group event — the plural-object precedent (the resultative rule's "when the object is a plural group, distribution wins") licenses distributing over a Patient group exactly as over an Agent group.
notes: Everything else is right: sail_out kept whole with no genus, both definite plurals as group witnesses, the agentless passive omitting its Agent, "lit" lemmatized to the verb light, unmarked habitual tense, and the temporal connective taking (Before <earlier> <later>) with no connective atom.
